input.title: [Android] Outdent and Indent buttons are flashing when user taps any buttons on Command Center
input.body:
## Step to Reproduce
1. Create a thought
2. While caret is on the newly create thought, swipe up to trigger Command Center
3. Tap Favorite button

## Current behavior
Outdent and Indent buttons are flashing 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1aff77c2-e005-4648-b21d-4273afe8b48a

## Expected behavior
Outdent and Indent buttons should only flash when user interacts with the intended button
